messages:
yara: dropped a draft for the 'history replay' idea — small timeline with expandable snapshot pins, inline canary split, and a persistent 'Pin snapshot' action. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/replay (frame 6). looking for accessibility and microcopy feedback.

olaf: first pass: love the snapshot pins. question: when you pin a snapshot, does it freeze the KV cache view or just the UI? we should clarify copy: 'Pin snapshot (UI only)' vs 'Pin snapshot (freeze state)'.

penny: a11y note: pinned snapshots need clear keyboard affordance. recommend adding aria-pressed on pin toggles and tabindex=0 on pins. also provide aria-label like 'Pin snapshot at v14, 2026-03-10'.

sam: microcopy: the inline canary label reads 'v14 • 5%'. suggest 'v14 — Canary 5%' for clarity in compact mode. for the pin CTA, 'Pin snapshot' is fine but tooltips should say what pin does: 'Pin snapshot: retains this timeline view and prevents auto-replay'.

aria-bot: automated check results:
- Pins missing aria-pressed (6 occurrences).
- Tooltip text not present on collapsed pin (suggest aria-label on button).
- Contrast issue: small timestamp text in compact mode 3.4:1 on light background.

yara: good catches. Olaf — the intent is UI-only snapshot, not freezing runtime caches. we'll update the modal copy to be explicit.

olaf: ok, then modal copy should use verb 'Keep this view' not 'Freeze', e.g., header: 'Pin snapshot — keep this view'. avoids implying backend state.

penny: keyboard focus flow: when you open a snapshot panel via Enter, focus should move into the panel and the close button should be first focus. on close, restore focus to the originating pin. add data-focus-source attr to help.

sam: interaction nit: when replaying the timeline the scrub handle auto-plays; keyboard users want to step frames not autoplay. add a preference toggle 'auto-play on open' and default it off. expose step controls: frame forward/back by 1, and jump to next allocation change with Shift+Arrow. add aria-roledescription='history scrubber' and aria-valuetext '{version}, {percent} allocation'.

aria-bot: additional lint:
- Missing aria-roledescription on scrub control.
- Small timestamp contrast fail in compact mode (suggest increase font weight to 600 or darken to reach 4.5:1).
- Pin button missing accessible name when icon-only (add aria-label).

yara: action items:
- design: update pin modal header to 'Pin snapshot — keep this view' and add tooltip copy (yara + olaf)
- eng: add aria-pressed to pin toggles, aria-roledescription + aria-valuetext on scrubber, implement focus restore via data-focus-source (penny + sam)
- writing: short tooltip lines for pin and compact canary label options (sam)
- infra/styles: bump timestamp weight or color token for compact mode (olaf)

penny: quick test plan I'll run: verify focus restore, voiceover reads 'Pinned snapshot at v14, 5 percent', ensure pin toggle reachable via keyboard and has aria-pressed true/false.

sam: i'll draft the tooltip copy: (1) 'Pin snapshot — keep this timeline view (UI only)' (2) compact label 'v14 • Canary 5% (pin to lock view)'. will push variants.

yara: can we get updated frames by Friday? will sync with engineering on Monday for handoff. thanks all :raised_hands:
